statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
Cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated for extended ambulatory assessment
The service is to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
